status: finite topological-sector, dilute-gas, MacDowell-Mansouri and mixed-axion audit; not a gravitational-instanton measure or a Yang-Mills mass-gap proof

characteristicClassSeparation.color: Q_c=(1/8 pi^2) integral tr(F_c wedge F_c) is the second characteristic number of the compact internal color bundle, with normalization chosen so Q_c is integral
characteristicClassSeparation.gravityPontryagin: Q_P is the normalized first Pontryagin number of the tangent/Lorentz bundle
characteristicClassSeparation.gravityEuler: chi(M)=(1/32 pi^2) integral epsilon_abcd R^ab wedge R^cd on a closed oriented four-manifold
characteristicClassSeparation.noCanonicalEquality: Q_c, Q_P and chi(M) are characteristic numbers of different bundles. Equality or a diagonal sum is extra correspondence data, not a consequence of Spin(2,3), E6 or bundle topology.

compactYangMills.euclideanActionBound: S_YM >= 8 pi^2 |Q_c|/g_c^2, saturated by self-dual or anti-self-dual instantons
compactYangMills.periodicity: theta_c is identified modulo 2 pi when Q_c is integral
compactYangMills.decision: Topology quantizes Q_c and makes theta periodic; it does not fix g_c, the instanton determinant, the size integral or the RG-generated dimensional scale.

finiteSectorWitness.decision: The integer sector sum determines a periodic shape only after the continuous suppression A and the volume/prefactor have been supplied.

diluteInstantonGasWitness.dimension: K and chi_top have mass dimension four in four spacetime dimensions
diluteInstantonGasWitness.decision: Topology fixes the cosine and periodicity; K carries the scale and depends on the coupling, measure, determinants, matter zero modes and RG running.

largeNMultibranchWitness.decision: Branch minimization restores 2 pi periodicity and permits a cusp at theta=pi without a dilute gas. The overall curvature chi remains an independent dynamical observable, so the scale no-go is unchanged.

macdowellMansouriTopologicalSector.actionDecomposition: S_MM=(ell^2/8 kappa) integral epsilon R wedge R + Einstein-Cartan + cosmological term

pontryagin.periodicity: theta_g is periodic modulo 2 pi after an integral normalization is chosen

niehYan.identity: d(e^a wedge T_a)=T^a wedge T_a-e^a wedge e^b wedge R_ab
niehYan.role: the full Spin(2,3) Pontryagin density decomposes into Lorentz Pontryagin plus a convention-dependent multiple of the Nieh-Yan boundary density
niehYan.scaleDecision: a constant coefficient changes boundary/topological weighting but supplies no local mass scale

macdowellMansouriTopologicalSector.decision: The minimal action relates the local cosmological term and Euler coefficient through the unfixed x. Quantization of chi(M) does not quantize x, and fixed-topology local equations do not determine it.

forcedDiagonalChargeTest.ansatz: restrict the path integral by hand to Q_c=Q_P=Q
forcedDiagonalChargeTest.decision: Even the imposed diagonal identification merely adds continuous actions and angles. It suppresses fluctuations but does not derive A_c, A_g, either determinant, or a dimensional scale.

susceptibilityAndVacuumEnergy.qcdScalingStatement: chi_QCD is a dimension-four dynamical observable of order a QCD scale to the fourth power, not an integer characteristic number
susceptibilityAndVacuumEnergy.cosmologicalConstantRenormalization: E(0) and every theta-independent vacuum contribution renormalize the independent cosmological counterterm
susceptibilityAndVacuumEnergy.nonCancellation: relaxing theta to a minimum can remove the theta-dependent excess but does not set the additive E(0) or the renormalized cosmological constant to zero
susceptibilityAndVacuumEnergy.decision: Topological susceptibility can transmit a pre-existing strong scale into an axion mass or theta-dependent vacuum energy; it cannot derive that scale or protect the cosmological constant.

anomalyAxionEscape.decision: A mixed anomaly can correlate angles, and an axion can dynamically relax one anomalous direction. With one axion an orthogonal angle remains; in all cases the susceptibilities, decay constant and additive vacuum energy are independent dynamical data.

sharedScaleAttempt.qcd: Lambda_QCD=v exp[-8 pi^2/(b0 g_c(v)^2)] times threshold and scheme factors
sharedScaleAttempt.gravity: M_Pl=sqrt(xi) v and ell^{-1} is fixed only if the selector potential supplies an independent relation ell v = constant
sharedScaleAttempt.topologicalFactors: gauge and gravitational sector weights contain independent actions, determinants and measures even if their integer charges are identified
sharedScaleAttempt.requiredPromotionLaw: an exact symmetry or UV saddle must fix g_c(v), xi, ell v, the two determinant ratios and the bundle map relating Q_c to Q_P or chi
sharedScaleAttempt.presentStatus: none of those laws is derived in the corpus
sharedScaleAttempt.decision: Topology can protect an angle's periodicity or an anomaly coefficient, but not a dimensionful QCD/AdS/Planck/cosmological shared scale.

closedFiniteRoutes: integer Yang-Mills charge by itself fixes the instanton amplitude
theta periodicity fixes a transmutation scale
the MacDowell-Mansouri Euler coefficient is quantized by the Euler characteristic
constant Pontryagin or Nieh-Yan terms change local bulk scale equations
identifying gauge and gravitational topological charges removes continuous couplings
topological susceptibility fixes the additive vacuum energy
large-N branch periodicity fixes the susceptibility scale
one mixed axion fixes both independent theta angles and the cosmological constant
one common modulus plus topology predicts Lambda_QCD/M_Pl or Lambda_QCD ell
remainingNonFiniteInputs: a well-defined sum over four-manifold topologies and gravitational instanton measure
a UV bundle correspondence deriving a diagonal characteristic class
a complete E6 and Spin(2,3) spectrum fixing all instanton determinants and thresholds
a symmetry or fixed trajectory fixing g_c(v), xi and ell v
enough axionic directions and anomaly data to remove every physical theta combination
a vacuum-energy principle fixing the additive cosmological counterterm
exhaustionBoundary.programmeDecision: No presently available topological, instanton, theta, anomaly or axion datum promotes the shared-scale ansatz to a prediction.
